landmark_pins.name: Jamuna Main Braided Channel
landmark_pins.description: Active deepwater channel with persistent specular dark radar return.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Permanent Water Body] Persistent open water signature: HH averaged -19.4 dB and HV averaged -22.9 dB across all 12 passes. Specular forward reflection off smooth water scatters L-band energy away from the sensor.

landmark_pins.name: Emergent Jamuna Char (Sandbar)
landmark_pins.description: Submerged during July/August monsoon peak; emerges as silt/sandbar by November.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Cropland (ESA WorldCover)] Monsoon flood submergence: HH backscatter dropped by -9.7 dB between 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-22 (reaching a minimum of -17.8 dB HH / -22.4 dB HV), consistent with new open water inundation.

landmark_pins.name: Sirajganj Floodplain Aman Paddy
landmark_pins.description: ESA WorldCover Cropland showing classic HV volume-scattering growth curve.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Cropland (ESA WorldCover)] Monsoon flood submergence: HH backscatter dropped by -16.7 dB between 2026-07-12 and 2026-07-24 (reaching a minimum of -14.2 dB HH / -20.4 dB HV), consistent with new open water inundation.

landmark_pins.name: Flooded Cropland Double-Bounce
landmark_pins.description: Strong L-band HH dihedral surge (+dB) from water beneath emergent crop stems.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Cropland (ESA WorldCover)] Monsoon flood submergence: HH backscatter dropped by -19.0 dB between 2026-07-24 and 2026-08-17 (reaching a minimum of -17.9 dB HH / -21.0 dB HV), consistent with new open water inundation.

landmark_pins.name: Flood Embankment & Settlement
landmark_pins.description: Persistent bright corner reflection used for radiometric calibration stability.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Tree Cover / Homestead Forest] High persistent backscatter (mean HH = 16.2 dB, HV = -10.2 dB): Consistent with dense settlement structures, embankments, or homestead tree cover.

landmark_pins.name: Monsoon Newly Flooded Basin
landmark_pins.description: Dry land in June that experienced a sharp backscatter drop during peak inundation.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Tree Cover / Homestead Forest] Monsoon flood submergence: HH backscatter dropped by -14.2 dB between 2026-06-18 and 2026-06-30 (reaching a minimum of -14.5 dB HH / -21.5 dB HV), consistent with new open water inundation.
